Most people drop a file into ChatGPT, type "analyze this," and call it a day. I wanted to know if the answer you get back is actually correct, so I gave it a sales workbook you would not wish on anyone.

The transaction sheet is just codes. No names, no categories, nothing readable. To get real numbers, ChatGPT had to look up product info, customer location, and purchase type from three separate master sheets, then do the math itself. No formulas existed anywhere in the file. It had to build everything from scratch.
